aboutHeading: Building stronger futures, one game at a time.
aboutParagraph1: AT Foundation (ATF) is a non-profit initiative founded by Anju Turambekar on 22 February 2022. Based in the Gadhinglaj region of Kolhapur district, Maharashtra, ATF works to connect rural communities with opportunities through sport, education and social empowerment.
aboutParagraph2: We believe football can be a practical classroom for teamwork, decision-making, discipline and respect. Through community-based programmes, we aim to reduce barriers to participation and create pathways for children and young people—particularly girls—to learn, grow and lead.
valuesHeading: A clear purpose. A community-led approach.
valuesIntro: We want every child to have the space, support and encouragement to discover what they can become.

vision.title: An inclusive society through sport
vision.text: To create an inclusive society where every child and young person, irrespective of gender, background or economic circumstances, has the opportunity to learn, grow and lead through sports.

mission.title: Turn participation into possibility
mission.text: To use football and other sports for holistic development—expanding access, promoting gender equality, building leadership and supporting talent while connecting sport with education, wellbeing and social responsibility.

programHeading: Programmes that go beyond the pitch.
programIntro: Our work brings football together with life skills, community leadership and opportunities for women and girls.

programmes.label: PROGRAMME 01
programmes.title: Village Football Development
programmes.description: Bringing structured football coaching to rural villages through regular sessions, equipment, talent identification and pathways to advanced training. Sessions also reinforce discipline, nutrition and balancing education with sport.

programmes.label: PROGRAMME 02
programmes.title: Village Leadership Development
programmes.description: Using football and community activities to develop communication, teamwork, problem-solving, decision-making and personal responsibility in young people—on and off the field.
programmes.image_alt: Girls learning and growing through football

programmes.label: PROGRAMME 03
programmes.title: Sports & Women Empowerment
programmes.description: Encouraging girls and women to participate in sport, build confidence and take leadership roles through girls' football, talent identification and school-community pathways.
programmes.image_alt: Girls and women participating in football

programmes.label: PROGRAMME 04
programmes.title: Mother Coaches & Leaders
programmes.description: Working with Coaches Across Continents and community partners to equip mothers and women with coaching knowledge, confidence and leadership skills.

programmes.label: PROGRAMME 05
programmes.title: School & Community Development
programmes.description: Connecting sport with learning and village life through activities around gender equality, environmental awareness, problem-solving and decision-making.

programmes.label: CROSS-CUTTING FOCUS
programmes.title: Life Skills & Wellbeing
programmes.description: Embedding healthy habits, nutrition, respect, accountability and positive decision-making into sporting activities to support whole-person development.

founderHeading: From rural roots to building opportunities for others.
founderBio1: Anju Turambekar hails from Bekanal village in Gadhinglaj taluka, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra. Her journey in football reflects perseverance, continuous learning and a commitment to widening access for the next generation.
founderBio2: She founded AT Foundation on 22 February 2022, inspired by her own experiences and the barriers faced by aspiring athletes in rural communities. Through ATF, her ambition is to build an environment where children—especially girls—can become better players, confident individuals and future leaders.
founderBio3: Her vision is bigger than football results: it is about helping children gain the skills and opportunities to shape their own futures.
